subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new typed agent/model-level generation timeout surface, or keep timeout control at provider/run/idle-watchdog level?
rationale: The central request is a new public config contract, and current docs already expose provider-level timeout control, so automation cannot choose the permanent precedence and UX policy safely.

options.title: Add typed per-agent-model timeout
options.body: Define a canonical agents.defaults.models timeout field, document precedence, and test fallback behavior for mixed fast, slow, and local models.

options.title: Keep provider/run timeout model
options.body: Leave users on models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds plus agent timeoutSeconds and close or retitle this issue to docs or support follow-up only.

options.title: Defer to narrower reliability fixes
options.body: Keep this issue blocked while landing targeted idle-watchdog and repetition-loop fixes such as #80349 and #44965 without committing to a new config surface.

recommendation.title: Add typed per-agent-model timeout
recommendation.body: Define a canonical agents.defaults.models timeout field, document precedence, and test fallback behavior for mixed fast, slow, and local models.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest history-backed owner for timeout policy and participated in product review around this issue.
